inputs.name: action_principles
examples: draws, slashes, blocks, slips, counters, sheaths, pursuit; fast and stylish

descriptions.en: Blade vocabulary and how stylish draws/blocks/counters must read
descriptions.zh-CN: 刀法组成与拔刀/格挡/反切的利落要求

descriptions.en: Output aspect ratio
descriptions.zh-CN: 输出视频画幅

inputs.name: audio_design
examples: synced steel, cloth, footwork, stone, dust, banners, breath; no dialogue

descriptions.en: Picture-synced location sound; no dialogue and only restrained low-frequency music by default
descriptions.zh-CN: 严格同步画面的现场声；默认无对白、音乐仅极克制低频脉冲

inputs.name: camera_language
examples: FPV close orbit, low orbit, rear-side cut, ground skim, thread between fighters, spiral on clash

descriptions.en: Allowed FPV orbit set; side/rear/low preferred over front-face
descriptions.zh-CN: 允许的穿越机绕拍集合；侧面/斜后/低机位优先于正面人脸

inputs.name: camera_motion_rules
examples: fast but readable; never chaotic flying; short impact shake aligned with force

descriptions.en: Speed, readability, impact shake, and key-moment sharpness
descriptions.zh-CN: 速度、可读性、撞击震动与关键清晰度规则

inputs.name: character_dynamics
examples: A presses with continuous pursuit; B is precise, defensive, stylish, suppressed but unbeaten

descriptions.en: Aggressor/defender contrast and the suppression-without-defeat relationship
descriptions.zh-CN: 双方风格差异以及压制但不击败的关系

inputs.name: clash_vfx
examples: sparks, transparent shock rings, black and cold-white tearing, stone burst, banner rip, dust wave

descriptions.en: Contact-frame VFX when the two palettes collide
descriptions.zh-CN: 两套特效正面相撞时的接触帧表现

inputs.name: dual_consistency_lock
examples: strictly inherit first-frame faces, bodies, wardrobe; never swap identities

descriptions.en: No identity swap / face drift / wardrobe-body change / third combatant lock
descriptions.zh-CN: 不交换身份/不变脸/不改服装体型/无第三者的锁定声明

descriptions.en: Total duration; the duel timeline must cover it continuously
descriptions.zh-CN: 视频总时长，对拼时间线必须连续覆盖

inputs.name: ending_directive
examples: B almost kneels then recovers; A stands with advantage; FPV pull-back to unresolved standoff

descriptions.en: How the unresolved suppression ending is staged
descriptions.zh-CN: 压制但不击败的收尾如何落幅

inputs.name: environment_destruction
examples: tiles crack, pillars split, beams burst, banners tear, stones fly, dust waves with mass

descriptions.en: Which objects break, how far, and that debris has mass and direction
descriptions.zh-CN: 哪些物件可碎、碎到什么程度，以及碎片的质量与方向

inputs.name: fight_arc
examples: A opens aggressive, B is forced onto defense, B's one stylish counter is broken, unresolved standoff

descriptions.en: Suppression-without-defeat phase arc
descriptions.zh-CN: 压制但不击败的阶段弧线

descriptions.en: Per-beat choreography: time range, FPV move, origin/path/contact/result, bound VFX, debris, momentum handoff
descriptions.zh-CN: 逐拍攻防编排：时间区间、穿越机运镜、起点/路径/接触点/结果、绑定特效、环境反应、惯性延续

labels.zh-CN: 角色 A 身份特征

descriptions.en: Left-side aggressor face, hair, wardrobe, weapon, and temperament
descriptions.zh-CN: 左侧压迫方的面部、发型、服装、武器与气质

inputs.name: fighter_a_vfx
examples: black ink-wind afterimages, dark-grey torn air, thread-like blade qi, black-feather debris

labels.zh-CN: 角色 A 特效体系

descriptions.en: Darker, wilder, invasive blade-VFX language bound to A's cuts
descriptions.zh-CN: 更黑、更狂、更具侵略性、绑定 A 刀路的特效语言

labels.zh-CN: 角色 B 身份特征

descriptions.en: Right-side defender face, hair, wardrobe, weapon, and temperament; follow first-frame right figure
descriptions.zh-CN: 右侧防守方的面部、发型、服装、武器与气质；严格参考首帧右侧人物

inputs.name: fighter_b_vfx
examples: cold-white vacuum cuts, silver transparent arcs, thin air-slash lines, faint white afterimages

labels.zh-CN: 角色 B 特效体系

descriptions.en: Colder, cleaner, sharper blade-VFX language bound to B's blocks and counters
descriptions.zh-CN: 更冷、更净、更锐利、绑定 B 格挡与反切的特效语言

inputs.name: final_feel
examples: high-end action demo: fast, stylish, VFX-heavy, readable, cinematic not cheap xianxia glow

descriptions.en: Overall feel declaration of the final footage
descriptions.zh-CN: 成片整体气质声明

descriptions.en: Seconds to hold the first-frame composition before the first FPV orbit
descriptions.zh-CN: 进入第一圈穿越机环绕前，钉住首帧构图的秒数

inputs.name: first_frame_ref
examples: @image1

descriptions.en: t=0 two-person composition and visual baseline @-ref
descriptions.zh-CN: 第 0 秒双人构图与人物视觉基准的 @ 引用

inputs.name: footage_style
examples: 16:9 cinematic photoreal live-action, strict 30s, 24fps

descriptions.en: Overall footage style declaration
descriptions.zh-CN: 整体影像气质声明

descriptions.en: Output frame rate
descriptions.zh-CN: 输出视频帧率

inputs.name: lighting_palette
examples: hard-edge sunlight through broken roofs, volumetric dust, cold metal highlights

descriptions.en: Key light, rim light, palette, and material requirements
descriptions.zh-CN: 主光、轮廓光、主色调与材质要求

inputs.name: negative_prompts
examples: no sluggish motion, standing duels, front-face holds, magic orbs, laser cannons, knockout, gore, scene change

descriptions.en: Negative constraint list; template defaults are merged
descriptions.zh-CN: 负面约束清单；模板内置默认负面项会并入

inputs.name: provider_banner
examples: Made with Seedance 2.5

descriptions.en: Optional delivery-platform banner line rendered at the top; omitted when empty
descriptions.zh-CN: 可选的投递平台标识行，渲染在 Prompt 顶部；留空则省略

inputs.name: quality_profile
examples: UE5-level lighting, PBR materials, fine cloth hair dust stone and metal sparks

descriptions.en: Lighting, material, and micro-detail quality bar
descriptions.zh-CN: 光影、材质与微细节品质要求

descriptions.en: Output video resolution
descriptions.zh-CN: 输出视频分辨率

descriptions.en: One-line summary of who fights whom and where
descriptions.zh-CN: 一句话说明谁与谁在何处对战

descriptions.en: Single ruined-street environment, materials, and atmosphere
descriptions.zh-CN: 同一处废墟街巷的环境、材质与氛围细节

descriptions.en: Opening left/right staging, movement path, landmarks, and axis rules
descriptions.zh-CN: 开场左右站位、战斗移动路径、关键地物与行动轴线规则

inputs.name: style_reference
examples: fast close-range high-pressure action-demo temperament; inherit lens language only

descriptions.en: Temperament/lens-language reference; never copies characters, locations, or shots
descriptions.zh-CN: 只继承气质与镜头语言的参照描述，不得照搬人物/场景/镜头

inputs.name: vfx_binding_rules
examples: every important cut binds aura to blade path, body rotation, footwork, clash, and debris

descriptions.en: How blade VFX must follow motion instead of floating unmotivated
descriptions.zh-CN: 刀气如何跟随动作，而不是无源漂浮
